name: Dream Sovereign (Psionic)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to manifest dream message or induce nightmare.

Benefit(s): When you manifest either dream message or induce nightmare, you gain the ability to augment them in the following ways:

Augment (dream message): For every additional power point you spend, you may target one additional creature with this power. You may send a different message to each target. If you spend 2 additional power points, you may hold a conversation with any number of creatures you have contacted with this power. Each creature (manifester and any targets) is capable of sending a number of messages equal to the manifester level of this power, but only between themself and the manifester. If you spend 2 additional power points, then the creatures may deliver messages that can be heard by all entities affected by this power. If you spend 6 additional power points, you may manifest a single power on the targets of the dream message. The power affects however many creatures it normally would, and targets are allowed a saving throw as normal.
Augment (induce nightmare): For every additional power point you spend, you may target one additional creature with this power. If you spend 2 additional power points, you may ensnare a creature in a nightmare dreamscape rather than allowing them a saving throw. For every 2 power points you spend augmenting this power, you may choose 1 additional feature to be added to a nightmare dreamscape you create using this power.
